backend-engineer.name: Backend Engineer
backend-engineer.description: Build the servers, databases and APIs that power web and mobile apps. You will learn a language like Python, design data models, secure and deploy services.

frontend-engineer.name: Frontend Engineer
frontend-engineer.description: Build the parts of websites and apps that people see and use. You will master HTML, CSS, JavaScript and a framework like React, with a focus on speed and accessibility.

fullstack-engineer.name: Full Stack Engineer
fullstack-engineer.description: Work on both the interface and the server. You will ship complete products, from the database and API to the screen, and are especially valuable at startups and in freelancing.

mobile-app-developer.name: Mobile App Developer
mobile-app-developer.description: Build apps for Android and iPhone. You will learn a cross-platform toolkit such as Flutter or React Native, design mobile screens and publish to the app stores.

ai-engineer.name: AI Engineer
ai-engineer.description: Build products powered by machine learning and large language models. You will learn Python, ML fundamentals, working with AI APIs, and shipping AI features reliably.

data-scientist.name: Data Scientist
data-scientist.description: Turn data into decisions. You will clean and analyse data, build statistical and machine learning models and explain the results clearly to non-technical people.

cyber-security.name: Cybersecurity Analyst
cyber-security.description: Protect systems and data from attacks. You will learn networking, operating systems, common vulnerabilities and how to detect, investigate and respond to incidents.

ui-ux-designer.name: UI/UX Designer
ui-ux-designer.description: Design apps and websites that are easy and pleasant to use. You will learn user research, wireframing, visual design and prototyping in Figma, and build a portfolio of case studies.

devops-engineer.name: DevOps Engineer
devops-engineer.description: Automate how software is built, tested and deployed. You will learn Linux, scripting, CI/CD pipelines, containers, Kubernetes and monitoring.

cloud-engineer.name: Cloud Engineer
cloud-engineer.description: Design and run applications on cloud platforms such as AWS. You will learn networking, compute, storage, security and cost control, and prepare for a cloud certification.

digital-marketer.name: Digital Marketer
digital-marketer.description: Grow businesses online through search, social media, email and ads. You will learn to plan campaigns, create content, measure results and run paid advertising.

graphic-designer.name: Graphic Designer
graphic-designer.description: Create logos, social posts, posters and brand identities. You will learn design principles, colour and typography, and professional tools, and build a client-ready portfolio.

video-editor.name: Video Editor
video-editor.description: Edit videos for YouTube, social media, ads and clients. You will learn cutting, pacing, audio, colour and motion basics, and deliver polished work on a deadline.

content-creator.name: Content Creator
content-creator.description: Build an audience and earn from your content on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok or a blog. You will learn niche selection, scripting, filming, editing, growth and monetisation.
